title: Project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a

de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,
com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais

exclusiva

Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais
para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. ii
com certeza é o seu lugar.

title: Planejador financeiro/ patrimonial e investimentos (pessoa física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador financeiro/ patrimonial e investimentos (pessoa física) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.
Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!
Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:
O Grupo Capital:
Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.
Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.
Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.
Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.
Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:
A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.
Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.
Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.
Responsabilidades:
Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.
Pré-requisitos:
Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Diferencial:
Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.
Você terá:
Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de
partnership
estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.
Modo de contratação:
Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

title: Dataops engineer (relocation to portugal)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Dataops engineer (relocation to portugal) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation. Minimum 2/3 years of experience as a Data Ops Engineer; Hands-on experience creating, automating, and maintaining data pipelines; Experience working with Dev Ops practices and cloud environments; English level B2 or higher; Availability to relocate to Portugal. Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage; Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model; Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers; Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness; Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time; Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community; We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education; Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages. What makes us different? Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy; We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift; We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude; We promote closeness and an informal environment; Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships. Your next adventure starts here! If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:. The future is waiting for you — and so are we! title: Líder de equipe externo- mercado pago - feira de santana-ba
description: Confira esta oportunidade para Líder de equipe externo- mercado pago - feira de santana-ba em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina. Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias. Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico. Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina. Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma. Temos um desafio para as pessoas que: Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites. Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação. Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros. A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas. Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão. Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe. Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por: Liderar time de 10 executivos hunters responsável por adquirir e desenvolver o relacionamento com empresas varejistas e prestadores de serviço com faturamento superior a R$ 30 mil. Desenvolver uma equipe de talentos, potencializando seu resultado a partir da excelência na execução, melhor experiência para os usuários, estratégias comerciais e um excelente clima. Colaborar para o desenvolvimento da proposta de valor e estratégia do segmento. Requisitos: Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando. Ter experiência consistente de vendas em empresas adquirentes ou de entregas porta a porta. Conhecer profundamente a região de atuação; Experiência consistente em liderar equipes comerciais; Estar disponível para trabalhar na região: Feira de Santana - BA Nós lhe propomos: Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo. Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores. Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas. Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :) No Mercado Livre, trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferentes perspectivas. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Religião, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQ+, Etnia e diversidade de experiências. Trabalhamos todas as nossas vagas com base nessa premissa. Faça parte do nosso time!

title: Project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

Consolidar e analisar informações sobre receitas e despesas imobiliárias, taxas de ocupação, rentabilidade e desempenho econômico dos imóveis.

Apoiar a elaboração de informações e relatórios destinados à Diretoria, Conselhos, Comitês de Investimentos e órgãos reguladores.

Atuar no suporte a auditorias internas e externas, organizando informações, documentos e evidências dos processos sob responsabilidade da Gerência.

Sempre nos dedicamos a lapidar talentos para revelar a vocação de cada estudante. Os alunos também sabem que nós reconhecemos, em cada um, um diamante a ser polido. Juntos, formamos uma comunidade de diferentes perfis e sonhos, presente em todos os cantos do Brasil. Oferecer a melhor experiência e aprendizagem a cada vez mais alunos, com eficiência, uso intensivo de tecnologias e valorização das pessoas, garantindo que nossos estudantes estejam preparados para os desafios do mercado.

Todos nós trabalhamos para o aluno, temos paixão por educar.

Agimos como donos, com orgulho de cada uma de nossas entregas.

Cada esforço gera impacto real e sustentável.

Incorporamos tecnologia em todos os processos, potencializando alunos, professores e

colaboradores.


Diversidade e ética 

Fazemos o certo, valorizamos as diferenças.

Contamos com profissionais que valorizam a inovação em um ambiente diverso, com simplicidade e ética. Nossas iniciativas sempre têm o aluno no centro da decisão , pois consideramos o seu sucesso como nosso.

Essa é uma oportunidade de estágio para atuar em uma área estratégica em consolidação, contribuindo para o fortalecimento das práticas de governança corporativa, gestão de riscos, compliance e conformidade regulatória da companhia.

title: Analista de qualidade, processos e experiência do hóspede
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de qualidade, processos e experiência do hóspede em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos contratando um(a) Analista de Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede para o Quality Hotel & Suítes São Salvador, 2ª maior complexo hoteleiro em número de apartamentos em Salvador, com 304 UHs , integrante da Atlantica Hotels.

Não é uma vaga de manutenção de papelada. É uma vaga de construção.

Em hotelaria, Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede não são 3 (três) frentes. São a mesma frente vista de 3 (três) perspectivas. A qualidade é a causa; o processo é o caminho; e a satisfação é o efeito.

1. Escutar avaliação, pesquisa, reclamação no balcão

2. Responder resposta pública + service recovery

3. Classificar tema, setor, gravidade, recorrência

4. Converter tema recorrente vira não conformidade

5. Corrigir não conformidade vira ação no processo em conjunto com lider da área

6. Medir o tema sumiu? a nota subiu?

O que você vai fazer:

Gestão reputacional do hotel. Análise semântica das avaliações e relatório com os temas positivos e negativos recorrentes, e monitoramento da nota frente aos concorrentes através do Review Pro, Booking, Google, Trip Advisor — a nota isolada não diz nada; o índice relativo, sim. Ler o que o hóspede escreve, entender o que ele está realmente dizendo, e transformar reclamação recorrente em ação corretiva. Nota não sobe com resposta bonita. Sobe quando o problema para de acontecer.

Service recovery: protocolo de recuperação (o que se faz, em quanto tempo, com que alçada), treinamento da Recepção e da Governança. Recuperação feita no check-out vale dez vezes a resposta pública feita depois.

Jornada do hóspede: mapear os pontos de contato e cruzar as quebras com os temas recorrentes das avaliações. É onde a jornada encontra o processo.

CRM de satisfação: identificar recorrentes no PMS, régua de comunicação, NPS in-house, e integração com o programa de fidelidade da Atlantica — quais deles se hospedam aqui, e como reativar.

Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade , manter a ISO 9001 viva. Auditoria interna, não conformidade, plano de ação, preparação para a auditoria externa.

Mapear e documentar os processos da Governança, de A&B, de Suprimentos, da Recepção e da Manutenção. Fluxograma, POP, indicador, documentação que as pessoas usam, não a que fica na gaveta.

Transformação Digital , em conjunto as gerencias e o setor de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) levar IA e automação para a rotina dos setores. Claude , Copilot , Chat GPT , Power BI , Clickup , Trello , etc. Não como buzzword: resolvendo o relatório que leva três horas e deveria levar cinco minutos.

Construir os processos que a gestão não tem e seus paineis gerenciais , bem como auxiliar as gerencias e o setor de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) a construir soluções integradas.

Quem procuramos:

Superior completo · 2 a 4 anos em qualidade, processos ou dados · ISO 9001 na prática · Power BI em nível de construção · uso real de IA no trabalho (queremos ver o que você automatizou, não o certificado que você tirou) · escrita clara.

O que NÃO procuramos:

Alguém que confunda qualidade com burocracia. Se o seu plano é criar mais formulários, esta não é a vaga.

Responsabilidades:

• Gerir a reputação nos canais de avaliação ( Review Pro , Booking , Google , Trip Advisor ): responder, classificar temas recorrentes e converter reclamação em ação corretiva de processo

• Manter o sistema de gestão da qualidade conforme a ISO 9001: realizar as auditorias internas e acompanhar as auditorias externas , tratamento de não conformidades, plano de ação e preparação para auditoria externa

• Acompanhar o padrão de serviço auditado pela franqueadora e coordenar os planos de ação

• Mapear e documentar os processos operacionais (Governança, A&B, Suprimentos, Recepção, Manutenção): fluxogramas, POPs e indicadores

• Implementar ferramentas de IA e automação nas rotinas administrativas e operacionais ( Claude , Copilot , Chat GPT , Power Automate )

• Construir e manter painéis gerenciais em Power BI

• Atuar como interlocutor entre as áreas operacionais e a Tecnologia da Informação

Requisitos:

• Ensino superior completo em Hotelaria, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou correlatas

• 2 a 4 anos de experiência em qualidade, processos ou análise de dados

• Conhecimento prático da norma ISO 9001

• Power BI em nível de construção de relatórios

• Uso demonstrável de ferramentas de IA generativa em contexto profissional ( Claude , Copilot , Chat GPT , Power BI , Clickup , Trello , etc ).

• Excelente redação em português

Diferenciais:

• Curso de auditor interno ISO 9001

• Experiência em hotelaria, preferencialmente com bandeira nacional ou internacional

• Review Pro, Revinate ou plataforma equivalente

• BPMN · Power Automate, n8n ou Zapier · Lean/Green Belt · SQL básico

O que oferecemos:

• Autonomia real em um projeto em construção

• Exposição direta à gerência e à diretoria

• Uso de ferramentas de IA de ponta no dia a dia

Como se candidatar:

Currículo para e com o assunto " Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede " .

title: Business specialist
description: Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. 1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system. 2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal. 3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces s. 4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci es. 5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir ies. 6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

description:

MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100 Bn+ industry.
What the Platform Team Does at MAVI
Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.
About the Role
We’re hiring a
Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.
What You'll Do
Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles. Serve
as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated. Build strong, long-term relationships
with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs. Support the end-to-end matching process
by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions. Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities. Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers. Provide support throughout the hiring
process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving. Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties. Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.
What We’re Looking For
At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role. Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment. Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric. High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information. Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change. Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach. Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.
Why You Should Join
Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business. No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness. Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :) Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Us
Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.
At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.
Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.
Role Overview
As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.
2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.
3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble
4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.
5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.
6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.
7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.
8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology
9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately
80 hours of audio content
within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.
10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery
Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.
Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.
Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.
Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.
Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English
This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Estamos crescendo os nossos times buscando novos talentos que queiram transformar o mundo da gestão do ciclo de vida de documentos com soluções inovadoras. Aqui na net Lex temos uma cultura bem forte, que se baseia em um ambiente colaborativo e descontraído para nossos net Lecos e net Lecas!
Valorizamos a diversidade e são muito bem-vindas candidaturas de pessoas pretas, mulheres, PCD, indígenas, LGBTQIA+ ou outros grupos minorizados
Sobre a oportunidade:
Estruturar e liderar o escritório de gestão de projetos (PMO) da net Lex, garantindo governança, padronização e entrega de valor nos projetos de implantação. O foco desta posição é criar uma operação de projetos eficiente e escalável, traduzindo complexidade operacional em resultados claros para clientes Enterprise e para a alta liderança, enquanto desenvolve uma cultura de projetos orientada a resultados em toda a organização.
Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades como PMO por aqui?
Governança e Padronização
- Definir e padronizar metodologias de gestão de projetos (Ágil, Tradicional/Preditivo ou Híbrido) em toda a organização. - Desenvolver modelos de documentos, relatórios, fluxos de aprovação e ferramentas obrigatórias para os gerentes de projeto. - Auditar projetos periodicamente para garantir conformidade com normas e critérios estabelecidos. - Monitorar indicadores globais de saúde do portfólio (ROI, desvio de prazo, controle de orçamento). - Reportar o status consolidado de todas as iniciativas para a alta liderança por meio de dashboards e relatórios executivos.
Gestão de Recursos e Riscos
- Otimizar a alocação de profissionais, equipes e orçamentos entre projetos para evitar gargalos. - Identificar e mitigar riscos interdependentes que afetam múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, traçando planos de contingência corporativos. - Intervir na resolução de conflitos por recursos entre diferentes departamentos, inclusive organizando a prática de gestão de partes interessadas, envolvendo clientes externos.
Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Cultura

title: Business specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.

2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal

.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

description:

Não é uma vaga de manutenção de papelada. É uma vaga de construção.

Em hotelaria, Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede não são 3 (três) frentes. São a mesma frente vista de 3 (três) perspectivas. A qualidade é a causa;
o processo é o caminho;
e a satisfação é o efeito.

1. Escutar avaliação, pesquisa, reclamação no balcão

2. Responder resposta pública + service recovery

3. Classificar tema, setor, gravidade, recorrência

4. Converter tema recorrente vira não conformidade

5. Corrigir não conformidade vira ação no processo em conjunto com lider da área

6. Medir o tema sumiu? a nota subiu?

O que você vai fazer:

Gestão reputacional do hotel. Análise semântica das avaliações e relatório com os temas positivos e negativos recorrentes, e monitoramento da nota frente aos concorrentes através do Review Pro, Booking, Google, Trip Advisor — a nota isolada não diz nada;
o índice relativo, sim. Ler o que o hóspede escreve, entender o que ele está realmente dizendo, e transformar reclamação recorrente em ação corretiva. Nota não sobe com resposta bonita. Sobe quando o problema para de acontecer.

Service recovery: protocolo de recuperação (o que se faz, em quanto tempo, com que alçada), treinamento da Recepção e da Governança. Recuperação feita no check-out vale dez vezes a resposta pública feita depois.

Jornada do hóspede: mapear os pontos de contato e cruzar as quebras com os temas recorrentes das avaliações. É onde a jornada encontra o processo.

CRM de satisfação: identificar recorrentes no PMS, régua de comunicação, NPS in-house, e integração com o programa de fidelidade da Atlantica — quais deles se hospedam aqui, e como reativar.

Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, manter a ISO 9001 viva. Auditoria interna, não conformidade, plano de ação, preparação para a auditoria externa.

Mapear e documentar os processos da Governança, de A& B, de Suprimentos, da Recepção e da Manutenção. Fluxograma, POP, indicador, documentação que as pessoas usam, não a que fica na gaveta.

Transformação Digital, em conjunto as gerencias e o setor de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) levar IA e automação para a rotina dos setores. Claude, Copilot, Chat GPT, Power BI, Clickup, Trello, etc. Não como buzzword: resolvendo o relatório que leva três horas e deveria levar cinco minutos.

Construir os processos que a gestão não tem e seus paineis gerenciais, bem como auxiliar as gerencias e o setor de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) a construir soluções integradas.

Quem procuramos:

Superior completo · 2 a 4 anos em qualidade, processos ou dados · ISO 9001 na prática · Power BI em nível de construção · uso real de IA no trabalho (queremos ver o que você automatizou, não o certificado que você tirou) · escrita clara.

O que NÃO procuramos:

Alguém que confunda qualidade com burocracia. Se o seu plano é criar mais formulários, esta não é a vaga.

você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a
uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos
de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,
com vídeos totalmente atualizados
. Mentorias semanais
com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma
exclusiva

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?
Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você
.

Maior de 18 anos
, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais
para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?
Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte de
uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas
, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Esta
não é uma vaga CLT

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a
ii
com certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!
O que eu faço?
Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

title: Analista de qualidade, processos e experiência do hóspede
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de qualidade, processos e experiência do hóspede em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos contratando um(a) Analista de Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede para o Quality Hotel & Suítes São Salvador, 2ª maior complexo hoteleiro em número de apartamentos em Salvador, com 304 UHs , integrante da Atlantica Hotels. Não é uma vaga de manutenção de papelada. É uma vaga de construção. Em hotelaria, Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede não são 3 (três) frentes. São a mesma frente vista de 3 (três) perspectivas. A qualidade é a causa; o processo é o caminho; e a satisfação é o efeito. 1. Escutar avaliação, pesquisa, reclamação no balcão 2. Responder resposta pública + service recovery 3. Classificar tema, setor, gravidade, recorrência 4. Converter tema recorrente vira não conformidade 5. Corrigir não conformidade vira ação no processo em conjunto com lider da área 6. Medir o tema sumiu? a nota subiu? O que você vai fazer: Gestão reputacional do hotel. Análise semântica das avaliações e relatório com os temas positivos e negativos recorrentes, e monitoramento da nota frente aos concorrentes através do Review Pro, Booking, Google, Trip Advisor — a nota isolada não diz nada; o índice relativo, sim. Ler o que o hóspede escreve, entender o que ele está realmente dizendo, e transformar reclamação recorrente em ação corretiva. Nota não sobe com resposta bonita. Sobe quando o problema para de acontecer. Service recovery: protocolo de recuperação (o que se faz, em quanto tempo, com que alçada), treinamento da Recepção e da Governança. Recuperação feita no check-out vale dez vezes a resposta pública feita depois. Jornada do hóspede: mapear os pontos de contato e cruzar as quebras com os temas recorrentes das avaliações. É onde a jornada encontra o processo. CRM de satisfação: identificar recorrentes no PMS, régua de comunicação, NPS in-house, e integração com o programa de fidelidade da Atlantica — quais deles se hospedam aqui, e como reativar. Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade , manter a ISO 9001 viva. Auditoria interna, não conformidade, plano de ação, preparação para a auditoria externa. Mapear e documentar os processos da Governança, de A&B, de Suprimentos, da Recepção e da Manutenção. Fluxograma, POP, indicador, documentação que as pessoas usam, não a que fica na gaveta. Transformação Digital , em conjunto as gerencias e o setor de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) levar IA e automação para a rotina dos setores. Claude , Copilot , Chat GPT , Power BI , Clickup , Trello , etc. Não como buzzword: resolvendo o relatório que leva três horas e deveria levar cinco minutos. Construir os processos que a gestão não tem e seus paineis gerenciais , bem como auxiliar as gerencias e o setor de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) a construir soluções integradas. Quem procuramos: Superior completo · 2 a 4 anos em qualidade, processos ou dados · ISO 9001 na prática · Power BI em nível de construção · uso real de IA no trabalho (queremos ver o que você automatizou, não o certificado que você tirou) · escrita clara. O que NÃO procuramos: Alguém que confunda qualidade com burocracia. Se o seu plano é criar mais formulários, esta não é a vaga. Responsabilidades: • Gerir a reputação nos canais de avaliação ( Review Pro , Booking , Google , Trip Advisor ): responder, classificar temas recorrentes e converter reclamação em ação corretiva de processo • Manter o sistema de gestão da qualidade conforme a ISO 9001: realizar as auditorias internas e acompanhar as auditorias externas , tratamento de não conformidades, plano de ação e preparação para auditoria externa • Acompanhar o padrão de serviço auditado pela franqueadora e coordenar os planos de ação • Mapear e documentar os processos operacionais (Governança, A&B, Suprimentos, Recepção, Manutenção): fluxogramas, POPs e indicadores • Implementar ferramentas de IA e automação nas rotinas administrativas e operacionais ( Claude , Copilot , Chat GPT , Power Automate ) • Construir e manter painéis gerenciais em Power BI • Atuar como interlocutor entre as áreas operacionais e a Tecnologia da Informação Requisitos: • Ensino superior completo em Hotelaria, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou correlatas • 2 a 4 anos de experiência em qualidade, processos ou análise de dados • Conhecimento prático da norma ISO 9001 • Power BI em nível de construção de relatórios • Uso demonstrável de ferramentas de IA generativa em contexto profissional ( Claude , Copilot , Chat GPT , Power BI , Clickup , Trello , etc ). • Excelente redação em português Diferenciais: • Curso de auditor interno ISO 9001 • Experiência em hotelaria, preferencialmente com bandeira nacional ou internacional • Review Pro, Revinate ou plataforma equivalente • BPMN · Power Automate, n8n ou Zapier · Lean/Green Belt · SQL básico O que oferecemos: • Autonomia real em um projeto em construção • Exposição direta à gerência e à diretoria • Uso de ferramentas de IA de ponta no dia a dia Como se candidatar: Currículo para   e   com o assunto " Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede ". title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Us
Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.
At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.
Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.
Role Overview
As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.
2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.
3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble
4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.
5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.
6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.
7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.
8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology
9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately
80 hours of audio content
within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.
10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery
Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.
Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.
Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.
Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.
Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English
This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U. S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

description:

As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.
You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.
Specifically, your role will involve:
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.). Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa). Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations. Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency. Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.
The ideal profile
We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside Move Up Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:
Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS). Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings. Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil. Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus. Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.
Next steps in the process ✅
First Interview:
A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements. Second Interview:
A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with Move Up Media. Third Interview:
A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team. Final Step:
A proposition for us to start working together!
What’s in it for you
Remote Work Environment:
Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:
We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:
As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:
Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:
€1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.
Move Up Media
We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!
Here at Move Up Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. title: Reiseberater:in brasilien (freelance, vor ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in brasilien (freelance, vor ort) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Travel Buddies Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.
Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.
Was du machst Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:
Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.
Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per Whats App, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.
Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.
Was du mitbringen musst Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen. Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch. Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich. Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per Whats App und im Video-Call.
Was zusätzlich hilft Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse Englisch fließend Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, Whats App Business Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas
Was wir bieten Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt. Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen. Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen. Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.
Role Overview
As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.
2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.
3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble
4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.
5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.
6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.
7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.
8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology
9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately
80 hours of audio content
within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.
10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery
Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.
Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.
Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.
Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.
Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English
This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.

Was du machst Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:
Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.
Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per Whats App, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.
Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.
Was du mitbringen musst Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen. Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch. Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich. Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per Whats App und im Video-Call.
Was zusätzlich hilft Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse Englisch fließend Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, Whats App Business Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas
Was wir bieten Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt. Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen. Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen. Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

title: Inside sales coordinator
description:

Organizes quote requests and internal orders, prioritizes and executes them within required turnaround times. Follows detailed instructions from SOP diligently.
